title_en: Stojan Set Off to the Mountain
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional-sounding. 'шега' in 'се бијат шега' is my reading as 'fight over a joke'; the line is slightly unclear.

lines.en: Stojan set off to the mountain,
Stojan set off, he gave instructions,
Stojan gave instructions to his mother.

lines.cyr: - Јас ќе одам мајко во планина,
lines.lat: - Jas ḱe odam majko vo planina,
lines.en: - I will go, mother, to the mountain,
to the mountain, mother, to the meadow,
to graze, mother, the white flock.
I leave you, mother, seven sisters,

lines.cyr: ти да гледаш мајко да ги караш,
lines.lat: ti da gledaš majko da gi karaš,
lines.en: you see to it, mother, that you keep them in check,

lines.cyr: да не скитат ноќе по сокаци.
lines.lat: da ne skitat noḱe po sokaci.
lines.en: that they do not wander at night through the lanes.

lines.cyr: Да не чујам мајко нешто смеја,
lines.lat: Da ne čujam majko nešto smeja,
lines.en: That I do not hear, mother, any mockery,
that the villagers do not fight over a joke,

lines.cyr: да не ми се смејат другарите.
lines.lat: da ne mi se smejat drugarite.
lines.en: that my friends do not laugh at me.
